'''Module Tissue Spikes''' are crafting components used to create the [[Relay Tower|Relay Antennas]], [[Module Genic Receptacle|Module Genic Receptacles]], and the [[Metallurgical Infuser Furnace]]. They have no use outside of this.

== ''Obtainment'' ==
Crafting one Module Tissue Spike requires one Iron Ingot, three of any Glass, two Gold Nuggets, and one [[Infected Flesh]].{{CraftingTable|r1_a1=|r1_b1=Glass|r1_c1=|r1_a2=Glass|r1_b2=Infected Flesh|r1_c2=Glass|r1_a3=Gold Nugget|r1_b3=Iron Ingot|r1_c3=Gold Nugget|r1_output=Module Tissue Spike|r1_count=1}}
